info.title: Trem API
info.description: Public app API: shows, hero banner, video feed, trending, recommendations, categories, reviews, onboarding, auth, push (FCM), checkout, and more. **Booking sessions** (availability, budget buckets, seat map) live under `/api/shows/{showId}/sessions/...` — see tag **show-sessions** (not `/api/sessions`). CMS/admin endpoints are documented separately at `/api/admin-docs`. All endpoints except `/auth/*` and the OpenAPI UI require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (JWT from POST /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/oauth, or /auth/refresh-token).

reservation_id.description: Active seat hold from POST /api/booking/reserve. Required for seat-map checkout with price lock timer.

guest_email.description: Guest checkout — email only for ticket delivery. No password required; account creation is post-purchase.

points_to_redeem.description: Trem Credit points to spend. Converted with the System → Points redeem rate for the order currency (for example 100 points → SGD 10). Capped by the balance and the order total. Omit or 0 to pay the full amount.

payment_url.description: Sandbox WebView URL (null when payment_gateway is stripe)

client_secret.description: Stripe PaymentIntent client_secret for Payment Sheet (null for sandbox)

stripe_publishable_key.description: Stripe publishable key for Payment Sheet (null for sandbox)

service_fee_total.description: Trem Tix service fee total (S$2.50 × ticket count)

total_seats_purchases.description: Seats purchased (same field as CMS simulate)

points_redeemed.description: Trem Credit points taken off this order

points_discount.description: Money value of points_redeemed in the order currency

status.description: paid when points cover the full total and tickets are issued immediately

checkout_id.description: Checkout order id (same as checkout_id from POST /checkout)

payment_id.description: Latest payment id for this order

status.description: Unified status for clients (derived from order)

ticket_number.description: Unique 8-digit running ticket number (shown on ticket / QR)

qr_payload.description: Encode this HTTPS URL as a QR code (iPhone Camera opens Safari). Token: TRM:v1:{ticketNumber}:{qrCode}

barcode_payload.description: Code128 barcode value (TRM token, no HTTPS wrapper).

qr_payload.description: Convenience: tickets[0].qr_payload when at least one ticket exists

barcode_payload.description: Convenience: tickets[0].barcode_payload when at least one ticket exists

email_sent.description: True when guest_email was set on the order (delivery target recorded)

seat_ids.description: Venue seat UUIDs to hold (must match checkout quantity)

guest_email.description: Guest email for ticket delivery (no account required at checkout)

seconds_remaining.description: Seconds until seat hold expires (8 min from create)

timer_paused.description: True while payment is in 3DS redirect (timer frozen)

show_id.description: Show opened from this trending reel

eligible.description: True when the user may write a review for this show

has_ticket.description: True when the user owns a purchased or used ticket for this show

session_passed.description: True when at least one of those tickets is for a session that has already started or passed

skip.description: If true, skip interests; do not send selections

selections.description: At least 2 category ids when skip is not true

title.example: Moulin Rouge! The Musical makes its Southeast Asia debut

content_html.example: The hit Broadway musical opens in Singapore in February 2027.

main.description: Main article for its tag(s). Only one main per tag.

show_in_homepage.description: Whether this article should appear on the homepage.

total_responded.description: Total survey_result rows for this survey

percentage_interested.description: Percentage of yes answers (0–100, two decimal places)

notify.description: Whether the user opted in to notifications for this survey

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when the result was first created
